prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final transparent cinematic title lockup for a game loading screen. Produce a wide horizontal transparent PNG with two centered text rows and one very fine horizontal rule. This is original classical film-poster typography, with elegant high-contrast Didone/Roman serif capitals: fine hairlines, substantial vertical stems, generous but balanced letter spacing. Main text verbatim on ONE SINGLE UNBROKEN LINE: "VIIMEINEN KEISARI". Below it, substantially smaller (about 45% of main cap height), centered Chinese Song/Ming serif typography, text verbatim: "末代皇帝 · 北京". The middle dot is U+00B7 with a space on both sides. Add one very thin straight horizontal rule between the main row and Chinese row, about 75% of the main text width. Leave clear transparent vertical space separating all three components so they can be separated into individual production layers. Render all glyphs and rule in uniform very dark warm ink #231e1a, crisp and flat, no texture or distressing. Main line must dominate, Chinese line delicate and classical. Use a large high-resolution canvas, target 3200px width if possible; no clipping or stray marks. Entire canvas genuinely transparent behind and inside letter counters. No opaque background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no title shadow, no outline, no gold, no border, no backplate, no illustration, no extra text, no characters, no credits. Do not imitate any existing film logo, extended letters, connected letter flourishes or descending logo forms. Produce only the isolated typographic design.
